# Phase Two — Constraint, Risk, and File Plan

The Awtsmoos hides infinite breadth behind a simple door;
Awtsmoos.com should reveal more worlds without making the user endure more visual roar.

## What must remain simple

The homepage is already intentionally sparse. Do not add a giant persistent app/game wall. Preserve the hero, direct navigation, featured cards, mobile dock, and current aesthetic unless runtime proves a defect. The new breadth belongs in the retractable Worlds launcher and search layer.

## Real constraints discovered

- `index.html` is already modified by concurrent work.
- `apps/index.html`, `apps/style.css`, app catalog files, `games/index.html`, and `games/style.css` are also modified.
- Homepage discovery currently uses a 14-record `WORLD_CATALOG`.
- Apps already have 69 public records and Games have 26 records.
- The homepage launcher should therefore consume catalogs instead of manually duplicating records.
- Publication must exclude tests, debug tools, dead experiment folders, and infrastructure-only pages unless they are clearly intended for end users.

## Planned file ownership

Preferred clean additions:
- `scripts/home-simple/constellation-catalog.js` — normalize Core + Apps + Games into lightweight grouped discovery records.
- `scripts/home-simple/constellation-sections.js` — retractable group state and filtering policy.
- `style/home-simple/constellation-groups.css` — clean group headings/collapse animations.
- `scripts/home-simple/catalog-completeness.test.mjs` — filesystem/catalog completeness contract if tests can import both catalogs safely.

Existing files touched only if fully read first:
- `scripts/home-simple/index.js` — composition import only.
- `scripts/home-simple/world-launcher-renderer.js` — only if current renderer cannot consume grouped records.
- `scripts/home-simple/launcher-filter.js` — only if current filter assumes flat 14-item catalog.
- `index.html` — avoid if possible because it is dirty; use existing launcher DOM hooks.
- app/game catalog leaf modules — add missing legitimate entries only after filesystem verification.
- `games/index.html` — fix stale counts only if no dynamic renderer already overrides them.

## Risk graph

Catalog duplication -> future drift -> missing unpublished apps again.
Too many launcher cards -> mobile clutter -> retractable grouping required.
Importing huge runtime modules -> slower homepage -> catalogs are data-only modules, acceptable if measured.
Dirty existing files -> merge collision -> prefer new modules and minimal full-file rewrites of small composition files.
Raw filesystem discovery in browser -> impossible/static hosting mismatch -> publication remains source-catalog driven.
Experimental game publication -> broken public route -> smoke-check candidate before catalog promotion.

## Verification

- Catalog completeness diff becomes empty for legitimate first-level launchable app/game routes.
- Homepage launcher count matches normalized catalog count.
- Search finds newly exposed titles.
- Groups retract and expand with keyboard-accessible buttons.
- Mobile launcher has no document overflow and does not exceed usable viewport height without internal scrolling.
- Reduced motion disables group/card movement.
- Existing homepage hero/featured/dock layout remains unchanged.
